name: flying sword
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see the sword, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 ft. and either make one attack against a target or return to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s hands.
If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies.
